sections.description: A named aggregate over the declaring entity's own rows (FR-044). @agg count without @distinct counts rows; with @distinct it counts distinct values of @of (a list in @of is a distinct count of the tuple). Unlike origin.aggregate, count is NOT distinct by default: a measure aggregates its own rows and dimensions reach only to-one paths, so no join inflates it.
sections.whenToUse: A number a dashboard shows: revenue, purchases, distinct buyers, last activity.

attrs.name: agg
attrs.description: The aggregate function. sum/avg need a numeric field; min/max refuse boolean, object and map fields; any/all (boolean OR / AND, Postgres bool_or / bool_and) type the measure boolean and take either a field.boolean in @of or no @of, when they ask whether some row (any) or every row (all) passes the measure's @filter / @segment.

attrs.name: default
attrs.description: Optional integer the measure reads when it would otherwise be null: nothing matched, every matched value is null, or (a ratio) the denominator is zero or null. The derived report field is then never null. Refused on @agg: count (a count is never null), on min/max over a field that is not numeric, and on @agg any/all unless it is 0 (false) or 1 (true). A ratio's operand carries its own @default into the ratio.

attrs.name: distinct
attrs.description: Count distinct values. Legal only with @agg: count.

attrs.name: filter
attrs.description: Optional row scope (a portable attr.filter over the declaring entity's fields). May use relative-date values ({ now: "-P7D" }). Combines with @segment by AND.

attrs.name: of
attrs.description: Dotted Entity.field reference(s) on the declaring entity, or Entity.field.member for a member of a value object stored with @storage: flattened (e.g. 'Payment.amount.amount'). A report that takes sum, avg, min or max of a numeric member must group by every non-numeric member of the same value object (its currency), so amounts in different units are never combined. A bare string is one column; more than one requires @agg: count and @distinct: true. Required for every @agg except any/all, which may omit it to quantify their @filter / @segment over the rows.

attrs.name: segment
attrs.description: Optional name of a segment declared on the same entity. Combines with @filter by AND.

sections.description: A named arithmetic expression (FR-044 R13) over measures of the same entity and the report's numeric attribute dimensions, typed decimal. @expr is FR-037 R5's first arithmetic wave: add, subtract, multiply and divide, each of two operands. divide lowers as a ratio does, so a zero divisor yields null. A report listing a derived measure that reads a dimension must list that dimension.
sections.whenToUse: A number computed from other measures or from a grouped value: utilization percent (billable hours x 100 / capacity), budget burn (cost / budget), net revenue (revenue - refunds).

attrs.name: expr
attrs.description: The arithmetic: { field: name } names a numeric measure.aggregate or measure.ratio of the same entity, or one of its numeric attribute dimensions (never another measure.derived); { value: n } is a number; { fn: add \| subtract \| multiply \| divide, args: [a, b] } combines two operands.

sections.description: A named quotient of two numeric measure.aggregate siblings (FR-044), lowered as numerator / NULLIF(denominator, 0) and typed decimal. A zero denominator yields null.
sections.whenToUse: Averages per unit that are not a plain avg: average days engaged per starter.

attrs.name: default
attrs.description: Optional integer the measure reads when it would otherwise be null: nothing matched, every matched value is null, or (a ratio) the denominator is zero or null. The derived report field is then never null. Refused on @agg: count (a count is never null) and on min/max over a field that is not numeric. A ratio's operand carries its own @default into the ratio.

attrs.name: denominator
attrs.description: Name of a measure.aggregate on the same entity whose result is numeric: a count, a sum, an avg, or a min or max of a numeric field.

attrs.name: numerator
attrs.description: Name of a measure.aggregate on the same entity whose result is numeric: a count, a sum, an avg, or a min or max of a numeric field.
